name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Saves and lists the signed-in employee's own expenses.

dependencies.name: receipt-agent
dependencies.description: Extracts merchant, date and total from an uploaded receipt before the employee corrects and saves it.

description: The single-page app an employee uses to sign in, upload a receipt, review/correct the auto-extracted fields, save the expense, and see their own expense list with a running total. Holds no business logic of its own beyond form handling and calls to expense-api and receipt-agent.
